consultations.doctorName: Dr. Roberto M. Manalo, MD, FPCP
consultations.subjective: Patient reports 2-day history of dry cough and mild allergic rhinitis. No fever, dyspnea, or chest pain.

physicalExamFindings.generalSurvey: Conscious, coherent, oriented to 3 spheres, ambulatory
physicalExamFindings.heent: Normocephalic, pink palpebral conjunctivae, clear nasal passages
physicalExamFindings.chestLungs: Symmetric chest expansion, clear breath sounds, no rales/wheezing
physicalExamFindings.cardiovascular: Adynamic precordium, normal rate, regular rhythm, S1/S2 distinct
physicalExamFindings.abdomen: Flat, soft, non-tender, active bowel sounds
physicalExamFindings.extremities: Full equal peripheral pulses, pink nail beds, capillary refill < 2s

consultations.assessmentDiagnosis: Acute Upper Respiratory Tract Infection (URTI) / Allergic Rhinitis
consultations.planAndManagement: Supportive therapy, oral hydration, warm saline gargles, adequate rest.
consultations.recommendations: Rest for 48 hours, stay well hydrated, return if symptoms worsen or fever develops.

prescriptions.instructions: Take 1 tablet at night for 5 days.

prescriptions.frequency: Every 4-6 hours as needed for headache
prescriptions.instructions: Take 1 tablet every 6 hours PRN for headache.
